narrative.overview:
Asol is a plain, confident shop window in black, white and grey, with the layout of a mainstream e-commerce store (the user's earlier ShopHub project): a white header with a black announcement bar, a search pill and a "Deliver to" chip; a two-column hero; a feature strip; photo category cards; a product grid; a black seller band. The chrome holds no hue at all. Product photographs (mangoes, sarees, sweets) are the only colour on any screen, so the merchandise is what the eye lands on.

Density is retail-standard: generous hero, comfortable 12–16px card gaps, 44px touch targets everywhere. Workspaces (Seller Centre, Admin) share the same monochrome and open with a solid black header band; on phones their sections live in a bottom tab bar. Space Grotesk headings give the black-and-white a little engineered edge; Plus Jakarta Sans keeps the body friendly, with Hind Siliguri catching Bangla.

The token names `brand`, `turmeric`, `madder` and `leaf` survive from an earlier coloured world as role names only; every one resolves to black, white or a neutral grey.
keyCharacteristics: Black, white and neutral grey only; product photos are the only colour.
ShopHub storefront layout: announcement bar, search pill, two-column hero, feature strip, category cards, grid, seller band.
Two-column catalogue with a sticky filter sidebar; filters become a bottom sheet on phones.
Solid black header bands on Seller Centre and Admin; bottom tab bar on phones.
Space Grotesk headings over Plus Jakarta Sans body; tabular numbers for every amount.

rules.name: The Black And White Rule
rules.body: Every UI colour is black, white or neutral grey. No green, mango, red, navy or any other hue in chrome, badges, icons or charts. The only colour on a screen comes from product and category photographs.

rules.name: The Role Names Are Not Hues Rule
rules.body: `brand`, `turmeric`, `madder` and `leaf` name roles (structure, attention, danger/money, done), not colours. New code may use them for their role, but must never reintroduce a hue behind them.

rules.name: The One Black Action Rule
rules.body: Each row, offer, sheet or form has at most one filled black button. Secondary actions are quiet (white with hairline); destructive ones are borderless ink text.

rules.name: The Ink Price Rule
rules.body: Every price and total is ink, semibold and tabular, with a smaller muted "from" or "Total" prefix. Prices are never tinted.

rules.name: The Words Carry State Rule
rules.body: With no hue to lean on, every status shows its label (New, Accepted, Delivered, Suspended), messages carry an icon (alert or check), and low-stock or attention counts carry text or an aria-label. A grey tint alone never encodes meaning.

rules.name: The Grotesk Heading Rule
rules.body: h1, h2 and h3 are Space Grotesk at −0.02em with balanced wrap; everything else is Plus Jakarta Sans. Do not set body copy, buttons or labels in the grotesk.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every price, quantity, stock count, score, distance and ID uses tabular numerals (`.num`).

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Headings, buttons, tabs and badges are sentence case.

rules.name: The Hairline For Work Rule
rules.body: Panels, lists, offers, tables and forms separate by a 1px `line` border, never by a shadow. Only photo cards, floating hero cards, overlap tiles and the auth card lift.

rules.name: The Scrim Rule
rules.body: Text never sits directly on a photo. The auth photo is dimmed to 70% over black and carries a bottom-up black scrim (92% → 30%) under white text.

dos: Do keep every UI colour black, white or neutral grey, and let product photographs supply all colour.
Do give every row, offer, sheet or form exactly one filled black primary, with quiet or ink-text secondaries.
Do print every price ink, semibold and tabular, with a muted "from" or "Total" prefix.
Do carry state with a word or icon (badge labels, alert/check icons, aria-labels), since tint steps alone are too close to read.
Do follow the storefront layout: announcement bar, search pill with Deliver-to chip, two-column hero, features, category cards, grid, black seller band.
Do put catalogue filters in a 260px sticky sidebar from lg and in a bottom sheet below it.
Do set h1–h3 in Space Grotesk and everything else in Plus Jakarta Sans, with tabular numerals for numbers.
Do keep tap targets at least 44px and put workspace sections in the bottom tab bar on phones.
Do route every image through the fallback component and load `-sm` thumbnails for cards and lists.
donts: Don't reintroduce green, mango, madder, navy or any other hue behind the `brand`, `turmeric`, `madder` or `leaf` tokens.
Don't tint a price, or fill a primary button with anything but black (white on black bands).
Don't use the running stitch as ornament; it means progress or the brand mark only.
Don't put text on a photo without the black scrim, or show a broken-image glyph.
Don't add shadows to panels, lists or forms; lift only photo cards, floating hero cards, overlap tiles and the auth card.
Don't use decorative gradients, blur or glass; the photo scrim is the only gradient.
